annotations.title: Mercury retrograde dates for a year

description: Lists every Mercury retrograde period that falls in or overlaps a year from 2025 to 2030, with sign, pre-shadow, station retrograde, cazimi, station direct and post-shadow end. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope. Paid tool: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.
name: mercury_retrograde_dates
